neighbours.label: the reader-question and myth-busting format: ' I' inside an FAQ-style question (Do I, Can I, Will I) and the word myth heading a misconception, as opposed to 'I' in ordinary narration
fire:
Frequently Asked Questions
Can I change my seat after booking?
Yes, up to 24 hours before departure.

FAQ
Do I need a visa to visit for a week?
Citizens of most EU countries do not.
Will I get a refund if the concert is cancelled?
Should I water succulents every day? No, once a week is plenty.

Myth: You lose most of your body heat through your head.
Fact: Heat loss is even.

Myth: Sugar makes children hyperactive.
Reality: Studies find no effect.
Let's look at five common myths about running shoes.
There are many myths about sharks, and most of them are wrong.
quiet: Last week I changed my seat on the plane and slept the whole way.
When I visited Spain for a week, I stayed with my cousin in Seville.
I got a refund after the concert was cancelled last spring.
I water my succulents once a week, usually on Sundays.
On cold days you should wear a warm hat and a thick scarf.
Children at the party ate cake and ran around the garden.
Let's look at five popular running shoes for beginners.
There are many species of sharks, and most of them avoid people.
